description: Helper functions for testing bitmap performance in Git, including various test cases for commands like 'git pack-objects', 'git rev-list', and 'git repack'. The functions define performance tests for full, partial, and bitmap-based pack operations related to Git's internal bitmap index features.

methods.name: test_full_bitmap
methods.description: Runs a series of performance tests related to full bitmap indexing in Git, including packing objects, rev-list commands with bitmap options, and simulated partial clone operations.

methods.name: test_partial_bitmap
methods.description: Runs performance tests for partial bitmap index operations, focusing on packing objects, rev-list with tree filters, etc.

methods.name: test_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Performs a series of packing, rev-list, and bitmap creation operations, including creating a specific bitmap state and testing incremental updates.
